name: Dobříč (Czechia)
description: Divided per saltire into a white upper triangle bearing a red fleur-de-lis, blue hoist and fly triangles, and a yellow lower triangle, with green edging along the diagonal lines.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 16 July 2014 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
